operationsReview.cleanupDefault: dry-run; expired sessions/artifacts only; exact ETags
operationsReview.jobArchives: retain for pilot lifetime; no retry-key eviction
operationsReview.backupMode: quiesced logical job snapshot; private encrypted destination; no sessions/tokens
operationsReview.restoreMode: empty partition; interrupted active jobs; durable recovery fence until provider reconciliation
operationsReview.consoleLogs: fixed schema; no credentials, identities, paths, headers, payloads or exception text

metadata.auth: dedicated managed identity, Storage Table Data Contributor at table scope
metadata.writes: create-only or exact ETag; never upsert

requiredBeforeStage3: Retain Stage 1 ARM64/AMD64 compatibility evidence; obtain actual Azure sizing only in the isolated pilot
Review concrete resource names, region, tenant, staff assignments and cost
Review metadata retention/cleanup and backup protection/operator ownership in HOSTED_OPERATIONS.md
Review separate hosted image and signed registry publication; never expose Stage 1 headless server
Review Entra secret and private token-store configuration and rotation owner
Review log retention/ingestion budget, alert thresholds and notification recipient
requiredOnIsolatedDeploymentBeforeData: Verify platform state/nonce enforcement, signed ID-token injection and unsigned header stripping
Verify unauthorized users, expired/revoked sessions and unassigned roles fail closed
Verify no direct ingress path bypasses platform authentication
Verify actual Table ETags, restart persistence and managed-identity table scope
Verify managed-identity cleanup/restore permissions, protected backup storage and recovery fence
Verify configured Host health probes and aggregate alerts without exposing sensitive logs
